name: Criminals
overview: The Scriptures reveal the experiences of criminals who were confined in prisons and dungeons, as seen in Joseph's imprisonment where the Lord granted him favor and prospered his work despite his circumstances. The narrative highlights both the harsh realities of confinement and the mercy of God that can accompany such trials. Joseph’s release from the dungeon by Pharaoh illustrates God's sovereign intervention and the eventual deliverance that can come even after wrongful imprisonment.
